subject: math
topicName: Geometric Figures on the Coordinate Plane
description: Use circle equations together with lines, points, and polygons to solve coordinate geometry tasks.
learningObjectives: Identify how points, lines, polygons, and circles can be represented on the coordinate plane
Use circle equations to decide whether points are inside, on, or outside a circle
Connect intersections of lines and circles to coordinate geometry conditions
Use distance, midpoint, slope, and circle equations in the same problem
Solve coordinate geometry tasks involving circles with lines, points, and polygons
prerequisites: Plotting points on the Cartesian plane
Reading center-radius form of a circle equation
